contract: Film synopsis and critical analysis provide thematic and formal evidence but do not prove personal close reading, completed gameplay, or faithful representation of the complete film. Keep film_analysis not_reviewed until a documented close read and real game walkthrough.

source_claims: The documentary turns on a striking asymmetry between a musician's disappointing initial commercial reception and the subsequent life of the recordings among listeners far away.
The narrative works by separating rumors and public mythology from verifiable knowledge obtained through the search.
film_form_notes: Investigation and conflicting degrees of certainty shape a retrospective documentary, rather than a guaranteed success story for a new act.
The viewer's knowledge grows by tested evidence and listening to different perspectives.
entries.original_civication_conflict: Mira receives a plausible invitation to rehearse and a separate claim that a promoter is interested; there is no confirmed paid booking, and the artist must distinguish an audience rumor from a documented offer.
legitimate_choices: Ask who initiated the offer, what the actual terms are and which person has authority to commit the venue.
Reserve a bounded rehearsal period without treating an informal inquiry as a paid contract.
Decline to hold additional days until a verifiable offer exists, while treating the creative relationship respectfully.
entries.persistent_consequence: Separate statuses for rehearsal, promoter inquiry and confirmed paid work must survive a later day; an artist does not become famous or receive payment from an unconfirmed rumor.
avoid: Do not transplant Rodriguez's biography, rumors of death, apartheid history or the documentary's investigation plot into Mira's Oslo story.
Do not promise career breakthrough or an audience because a film features rediscovery.

source_claims: The film structures an ordinary working week through small variations in repeated routines and creative observation rather than spectacular career milestones.
It treats everyday work, modest artistic practice and personal relationships as meaningful even without commercial success.
film_form_notes: Small temporal and visual repetitions can reveal a change in a relationship or a craft decision without inventing a major event.
A seven-day rhythm makes the distinction between time spent working and time spent creating visible.
entries.original_civication_conflict: Lea proposes an additional half-hour of testing around one unclear prototype function; the player has limited time, can work alone or with her, and must distinguish a trial conversation from a delivered product.
legitimate_choices: Accept a specific short prototype meeting and record exactly what will be examined.
Use the available hour alone for one bounded design question, with no invented appointment.
Protect a rest period while stating which work remains unfinished.
entries.persistent_consequence: The chosen function, time spent, actual meeting confirmation and next iteration should return after day advance; no instant startup success or contract emerges.
avoid: Do not copy the bus-driver persona, poems, partner relationship or a specific film incident.
Do not force dramatic burnout, a magical investor or guaranteed venture growth from mundane creative practice.

source_claims: The comedy follows workers through an interrupted ordinary shift with customer demands and unresolved private obligations.
An episodic day-in-the-life structure turns mundane work boundaries and conversations into recurring social conflict.
film_form_notes: Micro-scenes in one shift can accumulate frustration and different obligations without escalating every interruption into a large plot.
Workplace humor can make hierarchy and unclear expectations visible while preserving the worker's legitimate choices.
entries.original_civication_conflict: Lea has circulated Thursday to the board, but the invitation is for Friday. The freelancer can help fix the copy while protecting time already promised to another client.
legitimate_choices: Draft a short opening with the correct date and offer to finish the invitation.
Ask Lea to correct the board message and wait for the chair to confirm the job.
Flag the date, decline the invitation work, and complete the other client's correction.
entries.persistent_consequence: The stored reply determines the follow-up. A confirmed order leads to a link check and a delivery deadline. The chair approves a delivered draft or cancels after a delay when Lea sends her own short version.
avoid: Do not reproduce the convenience store, its characters, jokes, lines or film's events.
Keep the first playable installment distinct from a completed arc and verified close reading.
